question: After an exact-head standalone six-process run is posted for `lancedb-store.ts`, should the current human-review pause be cleared for merge?
rationale: The protected `clawsweeper:human-review` label requires an authorized maintainer to accept proof that directly covers the conflict-resolved runtime path; contributor assertions and test-only validation cannot make that decision.

options.title: Require exact-head runtime proof
options.body: Request redacted standalone six-process before/after output after rebasing, then approve only if every initializer succeeds and the table is usable and empty.

options.title: Accept focused regression coverage
options.body: Accept the current child-process Vitest coverage and dependency contract without a refreshed standalone transcript, owning the reduced runtime-evidence confidence.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head runtime proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted standalone six-process before/after output after rebasing, then approve only if every initializer succeeds and the table is usable and empty.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identified repository member involved in the current guarded review and automerge discussion.
